pages.title: SCE Electricity Bill Hike in Altadena: What Changed (2026)
pages.note: Altadena is an unincorporated CDP: CEC map SCE 99.5% (sliver in Pasadena Water and Power), Clean Power Alliance 99.1%; CPA's default for unincorporated LA County is 100% Green Power. The 'bill hike' is SCE's 2025 GRC (D.25-09-030) reaching rates Oct 1, 2025 (+13.1% PAO; CPUC +$15.52 on 500 kWh). Page states the CPUC summary does not mention the Eaton Fire and gives PAO's wildfire share of revenue (14%, incl. Wildfire Fund Charge); SCE's Altadena rebuild hub, NEM-on-rebuild, claims program (deadline Nov 30, 2026); CPA JRC table. Built hand-written because a CITIES entry would also create /solar-companies/altadena and an installer card on the LA County hub. qc-gate-tsx: 0 fail, 0 warn, 4 review (standard machine-undecidable checks).
